name: 프레야-스카디 (Freya-Skadi)
outfit: 진홍색과 금색 자수가 놓인 두꺼운 북부 가죽 갑옷
gloves: 금색 테두리가 둘러진 붉은 가죽 장갑
shoes: 털 장식이 달린 무거운 금속 장화
weapon: 거대한 얼음 결정이 박힌 붉은 대검
silhouette: 거대한 대검의 무게감, 풍성한 어깨 모피, 뾰족한 머리카락, 빛나는 금색 장신구
signature_motion: 대검을 땅에 꽂으며 주변에 얼음 파편을 흩뿌리는 동작
signature_vfx: 진홍색 불꽃이 섞인 차가운 백색 얼음 파편의 소용돌이
unique_features: 어깨를 덮는 풍성한 붉은 모피 망토
visual_en: A tiny, 40px warrior with platinum blonde short hair and sharp crimson eyes. She wears heavy crimson leather armor adorned with lavish golden embroidery and a thick, voluminous red fur mantle over her shoulders. A massive greatsword, embedded with glowing frost crystals, rests on her back. Her pale skin contrasts with the deep crimson and bright gold of her outfit. Small frost particles and golden light embers float around her heavy metal boots, which are decorated with tiny ice shards. The entire silhouette is defined by the heavy, jagged shape of the crystalline sword and the rounded, rich texture of the red fur.
pose_en: Standing firm with a wide stance, gripping the hilt of the heavy sword.
vfx_en: Swirling shards of frost-white ice infused with crimson sparks.
motion_en: Heavy downward slam creating an icy shockwave
